Introduction

idntt is an upcoming 24-member boy group under MODHAUS.

Following tripleS' success, it was reported on May 10, 2024 that MODHAUS was planning to launch a male version of the girl group, and that they would debut in the first half of 2025. Contrary to tripleS, where each members were revealed periodically, idntt's members will be announced by unit of eight members.

On June 30, 2024, it was revealed that idntt will be split into three units of eight that would reorganize periodically: unevermet, yesweare, and itsnotover.

On July 12, 2025, the group released the first eight members who would be promoting as unevermet: Kim DoHun, Kim HeeJu, HwangBo MinGyeol, Choi TaeIn, Lee JaeYoung, Kim JuHo, Nam JiWoon, and Lee HwanHee. On July 21, 2025, MODHAUS announced that HwangBo MinGyeol would no longer be debuting with unevermet due to ongoing allegations and the unit would debut as seven members as they confirm facts, with HwangBo MinGyeol scheduled to join yesweare if they are false. The unit debuted with their first mini album "unevermet" on August 11, 2025.

On July 30, 2025, former Boys II Planet contestants Kim Min Jun and Park Nu Ri announced that they had signed with MODHAUS and hinted that they would be debuting as members of the group.
